I can't issue a signed guarantee or send licensing documents myself over chat, but I can get our events manager to send over verification info — business details, address confirmation, and written confirmation of your date, price, and deposit terms — before you commit to anything. In the meantime, you're welcome to visit 1200 Market St in person, and we can also do a call so you're talking to a real person before any deposit changes hands. What date and headcount are you working with, so they can include the right details in that email?

detail.reason: Semantic paraphrase: the reply said 'confirm terms in writing' but the needles want 'written'. Widening the needle list only patches this wording; 'documented' or 'in the contract' would mis-fire next.
detail.intent: Does the reply concretely state what the venue CAN provide to reassure the guest - a contract, a written confirmation, documented terms, a verification call - without fabricating a licence number or an unconditional guarantee?
